Metric: Consistently sends reports, follows all required rules, SOPs, platform constraints, and documentation standards without shortcuts or exceptions.
What it measures:
Adherence to policies, SOPs, and legal/platform requirements

Accuracy and completeness of required documentation

Absence of violations, workarounds, or “creative interpretations”

Reporting cadence and accuracy

Metric: Executes required tasks and routines consistently, on time, and to standard—without reminders or supervision. Shows up on time and is present throughout the designated shift.
What it measures:
Reliability and consistency of execution

Respect for operational cadence (deadlines, check-ins, routines)

Follow-through on agreed actions, even when unobserved

Metric: Identifies, flags, and escalates risks early and appropriately to prevent avoidable damage or surprises.
What it measures:
Ability to recognize operational, compliance, or performance risks

Timeliness and correctness of escalations

Judgment on what requires escalation vs what can be handled independently

Metric: Takes full responsibility for outcomes, proactively resolves issues, and does not rely on others to close the loop.
What it measures:
Clarity of ownership over tasks and results

Proactive problem-solving vs deflecting or explaining failures

Closing issues end-to-end, not just handing them off

Metric: Communicates clearly, accurately, and efficiently, and collaborates with others only when it meaningfully improves outcomes.
What it measures:
Clarity, structure, and actionability of communication

Timeliness and relevance of shared information

Effective collaboration without over-communication or dependency

Metric: Demonstrates sound judgment, emotional control, and professional behavior, especially in ambiguous or high-pressure situations. Receptive to feedback and adjusts/adapts accordingly.
What it measures:
Quality of decisions in gray areas

Emotional regulation and maturity under stress

Professional conduct and representation of the company

Metric: EOD submitted on time, tasks completed as assigned, attendance & punctuality
What it measures:
EOD submitted before cut-off time
tasks completed within deadline
no missed deliverables
on time log in and out
meeting attendance

Metric: QA pass rate & SOP adherence, onboarding & offboarding compliance
What it measures:
QA score meets required threshold
SOP followed without deviation
onboarding requirements completed on time
offboarding and access removal completed correctly

Metric: Shift coverage adherence, responsiveness; unread & inactivity handling
What it measures:
Assigned shift hours fully covered
response time to messages - Slack, Whatsapp, etc
unread count within acceptable threshold
inactivity resolved promptly

Tasks owned end-to-end
timely status updates provided
handovers completed properly
supports team coverage when needed

Metric: Openness to feedback; improvement after coaching
What it measures:
Feedback acknowledged and understood
changes applied within review cycle
measurable improvement after coaching
